name: YouTrack
author: Allan Higgins
description: Tickets assigned to you in YouTrack, counted by priority in the bar and listed by priority in a popup.

barWidget.description: Shows P0:1 P1:4 P2:7 in the bar; click for the tickets grouped by priority.

schema.label: YouTrack query
schema.description: Any YouTrack search. 'for: me' is the assignee filter.

schema.label: Priority field name
schema.description: The custom field tickets are grouped by. Blank uses YOUTRACK_PRIORITY_FIELD, else 'Priority'.

schema.label: Priority order (most urgent first)
schema.description: Comma-separated, optionally Name=BarLabel, e.g. 'Urgent=U, High=H, Low=L'. Blank recognises P0-P4 and YouTrack's defaults.
